The tile repeats with slight irregularity and no hard seam. Duplicate: same pattern ID and identical thumbnail as 'Raw Linen' in Presets/Patterns/Artists Brushes Canvas.pat (ps_preset_70, item 8); the two are interchangeable.
use_for: burlap or sacking texture overlay (Overlay or Multiply)
rough texture source for Bevel & Emboss
avoid: a plain fill is a harsh black-and-white mesh: use a blend mode
text on top: the black gaps cut letters
colour work: the tile has no hue
cards.applies_to: a selection or layer filled with Edit > Fill (Contents: Pattern), a Pattern fill layer, a Pattern Overlay layer effect or the Pattern Stamp tool; it tiles every 176 x 178 px at 100% scale (RGB tile), so the grain's real size depends on the document's pixel dimensions: on a 300 ppi print file it looks smaller than on screen, use the Scale setting to adjust.
cards.how_to_apply: Patterns panel menu > Import Patterns... and pick <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Required/Legacy Patterns and More.pat (the harvest did not find this pattern in the panel's default list); 'Raw Linen' sits in that library (group 'Artists Brushes Canvas'). Then use it in Edit > Fill > Pattern, Layer > New Fill Layer > Pattern, or a Pattern Overlay effect. Script: load the file into the pattern presets, then an Action Manager make of a content layer of type patternLayer addressed by name and pattern ID (this is how PGD applied it).
cards.notes: Look from PGD's thumbnail: the pattern applied by script as a fill layer at 100% scale on a 300 px square shown 1:1 (176 x 178 px tile, so the repeats are visible); seams and line directions measured on the tile decoded from the .pat file (its left / right and top / bottom edges compared, and its strongest periodic lines). Tile size and colour mode read from the .pat file.
